name: Mind HK
summary: Mental health text line providing support via WhatsApp and text in Hong Kong.
description: Mind HK provides mental health support and crisis services for Hong Kong residents through text and WhatsApp, offering accessible emotional support in English and Cantonese.

sections.title: About Mind HK
sections.text: Mind HK is a mental health charity dedicated to improving mental health awareness and support in Hong Kong. Recognizing that many people in Hong Kong face significant mental health challenges but may be reluctant to seek traditional help, Mind HK provides accessible, stigma-free support through text-based services. The organization works to promote mental health education and reduce the stigma that prevents many people from seeking help.

sections.title: Text and WhatsApp Support
sections.text: Mind HK's text support line allows anyone in Hong Kong to reach out for emotional support via SMS or WhatsApp. Text 9385 9677 to connect with trained support volunteers who can provide a listening ear and emotional support. Text-based support is ideal for those who may feel uncomfortable speaking on the phone or who need a discreet way to reach out.

sections.title: Who We Help
sections.text: Mind HK's services are available to anyone in Hong Kong experiencing emotional distress, anxiety, depression, stress, or other mental health challenges. Whether you're dealing with work pressure, relationship difficulties, family issues, or general life stress, trained volunteers are available to listen without judgment.

sections.title: How to Get Support
sections.text: To reach Mind HK's support line, text or WhatsApp 9385 9677. Trained volunteers will respond and provide emotional support in your preferred language (English or Cantonese). Visit mind.org.hk for additional mental health resources and self-help tools.
